subject: ciencias
titulo: Main Parts and Types of Plants
contenido: Plants are living things that need sunlight, water, air, and soil to live. A plant consists of four main parts: roots, stem, leaf, and flower. According to their stems, plants are classified into trees, bushes, and grasses. Plants can also be divided into flowering plants, which make seeds, and non-flowering plants, which reproduce with spores or cones.
ejemplos: Deciduous trees lose their leaves in autumn and usually have broad leaves.
Evergreen trees keep their leaves all year round and make food with photosynthesis.
The mixture of water and mineral salts absorbed by roots is called raw sap.

ejercicios.subject: ciencias
ejercicios.texto: Plants are living things that make their own food through photosynthesis in their leaves. To carry out this process, roots take up water and mineral salts from the soil, forming raw sap. The stem carries raw sap up to the leaves, where sunlight and carbon dioxide are used to produce food. Trees can be classified by their leaves into deciduous trees, which lose leaves in autumn, and evergreen trees, which stay green all year. Flowering plants make seeds, while non-flowering plants reproduce with spores or cones.
